text: OVERDOSAGE Acute overdosage of iron may cause abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting and, in severe cases, cardiovascular collapse and death. Other more chronic symptoms include pallor and cyanosis, melena, shock, drowsiness and coma. The estimated overdose of orally ingested iron is 300 mg/kg body weight. Toxic effects are seen at 10-20 mg/kg elemental iron. When overdoses are ingested by children, severe reactions, including fatalities, have resulted. Iron Folate Plus should be stored beyond the reach of children to prevent against accidental iron poisoning. Keep this product out of the reach of children.
